cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a quiet coastal saltwater lido at dawn beside a low diving platform — she peels away a translucent protective sun-film from her upper arm after resting by the pool; an indoor skydiving wind tunnel lobby with a broad curved observation window — she relaxes after a flight session; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; an archery range of targets on a green field — standing; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing
